saga: Y1 Steward Osric the Gray: “The granary counts 40 measures — a season, no more. Plant a farm on open plains.”
Y1 Steward Osric the Gray: “Every wall and roof to come is standing in that forest. A lumber camp — near the trees, while they last.”
Y1 The raiders have set up camp in the wilds — Wolf's Rest. For now, it is only a nest of brigands.
Y4 Steward Osric the Gray: “When they mass at the tents, you have time yet. When the camp stirs — you do not.”
